title: Battle of Ican
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ican", at revision 1375962898, opens: "The Battle of Ican, occurred on 16 December 1864 near Ikan as a part of the Russian conquest of Central Asia. In the battle, a Kokand army under the command of Alimqul was defeated by a cossack detachment." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q12823517, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1864 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
